It does not duplicate any inbox item (other wall art in the inbox is Pattachitra, talapatra, Saura, iron, macrame and sabai)

At Rs 2,999 it passes only if cost stays at about Rs 800 excl. GST; at Rs 1,999 the cost share is about 40% and it fails

Wood claim: do not say 'rosewood' or 'GI-tagged Mysore inlay' without supplier evidence; Indian rosewood (Dalbergia latifolia) has felling/transit controls in Karnataka, so ask the supplier for wood source papers
Must ship without glass (glass_fragile is blocked); specify unframed or wooden frame only
Thin veneer inlay can crack or lift in courier or in dry climates; needs rigid corner-protected box
Supplier in Karnataka, so website-only under docs/05 (no Odisha APOB possible)
Weight not confirmed; small panels are assumed under 2 kg packed, needs a weighed sample
GST assumed 12% (HSN 4420/9701 unclear; may be 5% after the Sept 2025 handicraft rate cut); CA to confirm
Handmade variation; listing must say 'design may vary' and state exact size

review.claims_legal_check: 2026-11-26: Dalbergia latifolia (Indian rosewood/blackwood) is rated vulnerable (BSI NDF report, https://bsi.gov.in/uploads/documents/Non-Detriment%20Findings%20(NDFs)/NDF%20report%20-%20Dalbergia%20latifolia-low-final%20(1).pdf). Karnataka regulates felling, sale and transit of blackwood under the Karnataka Forest Act and Forest Rules 1969, Ch. XIV-A and XVI (https://future.indiankanoon.org/doc/74311907/). I found no source for a handicraft exemption. Mysore inlay's GI status was seen only on a weak source (https://rooftopapp.com/art-wiki/mysore-rosewood-inlay); the researcher cites cauverycrafts.com for GI No. 24. Under require_evidence_for_claims, we cannot say 'rosewood', 'solid rosewood' or 'GI-tagged' without supplier wood-source papers and an authorised-user certificate. A cheap 'rosewood' panel that turns out to be veneer on MDF or another wood invites 'not as shown' disputes.
review.weight_check: 2026-11-26: Exotic India lists a 19x19x1 in rosewood inlay panel at 2.20 kg (https://www.exoticindiaart.com/product/paintings/rosewood-inlay-panel-woman-returning-home-with-water-pots-and-child-ddh880). So a 12x18 in panel in a rigid box could get close to the le_2kg limit. Unweighed.
